questions.q_en: Which of the following objectives of the First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956) was largely achieved by the end of the plan?
questions.solution_en:
• The First Five-Year Plan focused primarily on agriculture, price stability, power, and transport.

• One of its significant achievements was food self-sufficiency, largely due to good harvests in the last two years.

Further Insight:

• First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956)

○ Architect: K.N. Raj

○ Target Growth: 2.1%

○ Actual Growth: 3.6%

○ Key Focus: Agriculture, price stability, power, transport

○ Model Used: Harrod-Domar Model

○ Key Events

■ Influx of refugees

■ Severe food shortages and inflation

■ Success due to good harvests in the last two years

■ Rehabilitation of refugees, food self-sufficiency, and price control achieved
questions.solution_hi:
• प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना मुख्यतः कृषि, मूल्य स्थिरता, बिजली व परिवहन पर केंद्रित थी।

• इसकी एक महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि खाद्य आत्मनिर्भरता थी, मुख्यतः पिछले दो वर्षों की अच्छी फसल के कारण।

• प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-1956)

○ रूपरेखाकार: के.एन. राज।

questions.q_en: The Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961), which emphasized rapid industrialization, is also known as the:
questions.solution_en:
• The Second Five-Year Plan was based on the model developed by Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis and is therefore referred to as the Mahalanobis Plan.

• It focused on rapid industrialization, particularly the development of heavy and basic industries.

Further Insight:

• Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961)

• Architect: P.C. Mahalanobis

• Target Growth: 4.5%

• Actual Growth: 4.3%

• Key Focus: Rapid industrialization, heavy and basic industries

• Model Used: Harrod-Domar Model, Mahalanobis' two & four-sector model

• Key Events:

○ Industrial Policy of 1956 advocating a socialistic pattern of society

○ Acute shortage of foreign exchange

○ Price rise of around 30%

○ Moderate success despite foreign loan dependency
questions.solution_hi:
• द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना प्रो. पी.सी. महालनोबिस द्वारा विकसित मॉडल पर आधारित थी व इसलिए इसे महालनोबिस योजना कहा जाता है।

• यह भारी व मूलभूत उद्योगों के विकास सहित तीव्र औद्योगीकरण पर केंद्रित थी।

• द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना (1956-1961)।

questions.q_en: Which of the following unforeseen events was a major reason for the failure of the Third Five-Year Plan (1961-1966)?
questions.solution_en:
• The Third Five-Year Plan was severely impacted by unforeseen events such as the Indo-Pak war in 1965, Chinese aggression in 1962, and a severe drought in 1965-66.

• These events shifted the focus from development to defense, leading to the plan's failure.

Further Insight:

• Third Five-Year Plan (1961-1966)

• Known as "Gadgil Yojana"

• Target Growth: 5.6%

• Actual Growth: 2.8%

• Key Focus: Agriculture as top priority to support exports and industry

• Key Events:

○ Chinese aggression (1962)

○ Indo-Pak war (1965)

○ Severe drought (1965-66)

○ Shift from development to defense due to conflicts

• Plan largely failed due to external factors
questions.solution_hi:
• तृतीय पंचवर्षीय योजना 1965 के भारत-पाक युद्ध, 1962 के चीनी आक्रमण व 1965-66 के गंभीर सूखे जैसी अप्रत्याशित घटनाओं से गंभीर रूप से प्रभावित हुई।

• इन घटनाओं ने विकास से रक्षा की ओर ध्यान केंद्रित किया, जिससे योजना विफल हो गई।

• तृतीय पंचवर्षीय योजना।

questions.q_en: The slogan "Garibi Hatao" (Remove Poverty) was associated with which Five-Year Plan?
questions.solution_en:
• The Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979) aimed at the removal of poverty (Garibi Hatao) and achieving self-reliance.

• This slogan was popularized by Prime Minister Indira Gandhi during this period.

Further Insight:

• Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979)

○ Architect: D.P. Dhar (initially)

○ Target Growth: 4.4%

○ Actual Growth: 4.8%

○ Key Focus: Poverty removal (Garibi Hatao) and self-reliance

○ Key Events:

■ Global oil price shock and inflation

■ Prime Minister's 20-point program after the Emergency (1975)

■ Plan terminated early by the Janata Party government in 1978
questions.solution_hi:
• पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974-1979) का उद्देश्य गरीबी उन्मूलन (गरीबी हटाओ) व आत्मनिर्भरता प्राप्त करना था।

• इस नारे को इस अवधि में प्रधानमंत्री इंदिरा गांधी ने लोकप्रिय बनाया।

• पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974-1979)।

questions.q_en: Which of the following factors contributed to the introduction of Three Annual Plans instead of a Five-Year Plan between 1966-1969?
questions.solution_en:
• The failure of the Third Five-Year Plan and the devaluation of the rupee led to a postponement of the Fourth Five-Year Plan.

• As a result, three annual plans were implemented to stabilize the economy and focus on agriculture during a time of food shortages.

• Political instability and war with Pakistan were contributory factors, but the direct cause for the annual plans was the rupee devaluation and economic recession.

Further Insight:

• Plan Holiday (1966-1969)

○ Description: Three Annual Plans were introduced after the failure of the Third Plan

○ Key Events:

■ Rupee devaluation to boost exports

■ Food shortages and inflation

■ Focus on agriculture through high-yielding seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation

■ Economic stabilization in preparation for future plans
questions.solution_hi:
• तीसरी पंचवर्षीय योजना की विफलता व रुपये के अवमूल्यन ने चौथी पंचवर्षीय योजना को स्थगित करने का कारण बना।

• परिणामस्वरूप, अर्थव्यवस्था को स्थिर करने व खाद्य कमी के समय कृषि पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने हेतु तीन वार्षिक योजनाएँ लागू की गईं।

• राजनीतिक अस्थिरता व पाकिस्तान से युद्ध भी कारण थे।

questions.q_en: The twin objectives of the Fourth Five-Year Plan were:
options_en: Growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance
Reduction in poverty and family planning
questions.solution_en:
• The Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974) had the twin objectives of achieving growth with stability and the progressive achievement of self-reliance, especially after the Indo-Pak war and economic sanctions.

Further Insight:

• Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974)

○ Ashok Rudra and Alon S. Manney Plan

○ Target Growth: 5.7%

○ Actual Growth: 3.3%

○ Key Focus: Agricultural growth, self-reliance, family planning

○ Key Events:

■ Indo-Pak war (1971)

■ Influx of Bangladeshi refugees

■ Poor monsoon in the last three years

■ Price situation deteriorated, making the plan a failure
questions.solution_hi:
• चौथी पंचवर्षीय योजना (1969-1974) के दोहरे उद्देश्य थे स्थिरता के साथ विकास प्राप्त करना व आत्मनिर्भरता की प्रगतिशील प्राप्ति, विशेषकर भारत-पाक युद्ध व आर्थिक प्रतिबंधों के बाद।

• चौथी पंचवर्षीय योजना (1969-1974)।

questions.q_en: The Seventh Five-Year Plan aimed at achieving growth through which of the following strategies?
options_en: Public sector expansion and heavy industry growth
Food production, employment opportunities, and productivity
Nationalization of industries and banking sector reform
Emphasis on the services sector and information technology
questions.solution_en:
• The Seventh Five-Year Plan aimed to accelerate food grain production, increase employment opportunities, and raise productivity, with a focus on 'food, work, and productivity'.

Further Insight:

• Seventh Five-Year Plan (1985-1990)

• Target Growth: 5.0%

• Actual Growth: 6.0%

• Key Focus: Food grain production, employment, productivity ("Food, Work, Productivity")

• Key Events:

○ India started recovering from the "Hindu Rate of Growth" with 6% growth

• Plan was considered very successful

• The "Hindu rate of growth" is a term that refers to India's slow economic growth rate from the 1950s to the 1980s.

○ The term was coined by Indian economist Raj Krishna in 1978
questions.solution_hi:
• सातवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना का उद्देश्य खाद्यान्न उत्पादन तेज करना, रोजगार अवसर बढ़ाना व उत्पादकता बढ़ाना था, 'खाद्य, काम व उत्पादकता' पर केंद्रित।

• सातवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1985-1990)।

• लक्ष्य वृद्धि: 5.0%

questions.q_en: What was the primary reason for the postponement of the Eighth Five-Year Plan from 1990 to 1992?
questions.solution_en:
• The Eighth Five-Year Plan was delayed due to political uncertainty and instability at the center following the collapse of governments in the early 1990s.

• Although economic issues were significant during the period, political instability was the primary reason for the delay.

Further Insight:

• Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992-1997)

○ Target Growth: 5.6%

○ Actual Growth: 6.8%

○ Key Focus: Economic reforms, liberalization, industrial growth

○ Key Events:

■ Political instability delayed the plan by two years

■ Liberalization reforms introduced

■ High growth in agriculture, manufacturing, and exports

■ Decline in public sector investments
questions.solution_hi:
• 1990 के दशक की शुरुआत में सरकारों के गिरने के बाद केंद्र में राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता व अस्थिरता के कारण आठवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना में देरी हुई।

• यद्यपि इस अवधि में आर्थिक मुद्दे महत्वपूर्ण थे, राजनीतिक अस्थिरता देरी का मुख्य कारण थी।

questions.q_en: The Ninth Five-Year Plan focused primarily on:
options_en: Growth with social justice and equality
questions.solution_en:
• The Ninth Five-Year Plan (1997-2002) was focused on growth with social justice and equality, emphasizing rural development, agriculture, and the social sector.

• While private investment and technology were important, the primary objective was social justice

Further Insight:

• Ninth Five-Year Plan (1997-2002)

○ Target Growth: 6.5%

○ Actual Growth: 5.4%

○ Key Focus: Growth with social justice and equality, private sector involvement

○ Key Events:

■ Focus on agriculture and rural development to generate employment

■ Emphasis on social sectors like education and healthcare
questions.solution_hi:
• नौवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (1997-2002) सामाजिक न्याय व समानता के साथ विकास पर केंद्रित थी, ग्रामीण विकास, कृषि व सामाजिक क्षेत्र पर बल देते हुए।

• जबकि निजी निवेश व प्रौद्योगिकी महत्वपूर्ण थे, प्राथमिक उद्देश्य सामाजिक न्याय था।

questions.q_en: Which of the following was a key monitorable target set during the Tenth Five-Year Plan (2002-2007)?
options_en: Increasing the share of private investment in the economy
Reducing gender gaps in literacy and wage rates
Establishing a comprehensive public health insurance system
questions.solution_en:
• The Tenth Five-Year Plan set "monitorable targets" such as reducing gender gaps in literacy and wage rates, along with improving other social indicators like infant and maternal mortality.

Further Insight:

• Tenth Five-Year Plan (2002-2007)

○ Architect: Not explicitly mentioned (Led by Atal Bihari Vajpayee government)

○ Target Growth: 8%

○ Actual Growth: 7.6%

○ Key Focus: Balanced development, gender equality, infant/maternal mortality reduction, literacy, and river pollution

○ Key Events:

■ Focus on governance and greater state involvement through Panchayati Raj institutions

■ Agriculture was positioned as the prime driver of economic growth
questions.solution_hi:
• दसवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना ने साक्षरता व वेतन दरों में लिंग अंतर घटाने जैसे "निगरानी योग्य लक्ष्य" निर्धारित किए, अन्य सामाजिक संकेतकों जैसे शिशु व मातृ मृत्यु दर में सुधार के साथ।

• दसवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना (2002-2007)।

questions.q_en: The Eleventh Five-Year Plan focused on achieving which of the following?
options_en: Expanding the role of the private sector
questions.solution_en:
• The Eleventh Plan was aimed at achieving "Faster and More Inclusive Growth," with an emphasis on social inclusion and reducing disparities.

• This plan sought to ensure that the benefits of growth reached all sections of society.

Further Insight:

• Eleventh Five-Year Plan (2007-2012)

○ Target Growth: 9%

○ Actual Growth: 8%

○ Key Focus: Inclusive growth, job creation, poverty reduction, addressing inequalities

○ Key Events:

■ India emerged as one of the fastest-growing economies

■ Economic growth was not perceived as inclusive for many marginalized groups (SCs, STs, minorities).
questions.solution_hi:
• ग्यारहवीं योजना का उद्देश्य "तीव्र व अधिक समावेशी विकास" प्राप्त करना था, सामाजिक समावेशन व असमानताओं को घटाने पर बल देते हुए।

• इस योजना का उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना था कि विकास के लाभ समाज के सभी वर्गों तक पहुँचें।

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statements about the First Five-Year Plan (1951 - 1956) is/are correct?

a. The plan was based on the Mahalanobis model.

b. One of its main objectives was price stability.

c. The actual growth rate achieved during the plan was higher than the target growth rate.
questions.solution_en:
• The First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956) was based on the Harrod-Domar model.

• One of the objectives of the First Plan was indeed price stability.

• The target growth rate was 2.1%, but the actual growth rate achieved was 3.6%.

Further Insight:

• First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956)

○ Architect: K.N. Raj

○ Target Growth: 2.1%

○ Actual Growth: 3.6%

○ Key Focus: Agriculture, price stability, power, transport

○ Model Used: Harrod-Domar Model

○ Key Events

■ Influx of refugees

■ Severe food shortages and inflation

■ Success due to good harvests in the last two years

■ Rehabilitation of refugees, food self-sufficiency, and price control achieved
questions.solution_hi:
• प्रथम पंचवर्षीय योजना (1951-1956) हैरॉड-डोमर मॉडल पर आधारित थी।

• प्रथम योजना के उद्देश्यों में से एक वास्तव में मूल्य स्थिरता थी।

• लक्ष्य वृद्धि दर 2.1% थी, परंतु वास्तविक प्राप्त वृद्धि दर 3.6% थी।

questions.q_en:
Which of the following is/are true regarding the Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961)?

a. It focused on rapid industrialization, particularly heavy and basic industries.

b. The plan was moderately successful due to a shortage of foreign exchange and a rise in prices.

c. It was based on the Harrod-Domar model and the two-sector model by Prof. Mahalanobis.
questions.solution_en:
• The Second Five-Year Plan emphasized rapid industrialization, especially in heavy and basic industries.

• It also faced issues like foreign exchange shortage and price rise, contributing to its moderate success.

• . However, the plan was based on both the Harrod-Domar model and the four-sector model of Prof. Mahalanobis, not the two-sector model.

Further Insight:

• Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961)

• Architect: P.C. Mahalanobis

• Target Growth: 4.5%

• Actual Growth: 4.3%

• Key Focus: Rapid industrialization, heavy and basic industries

• Model Used: Harrod-Domar Model, Mahalanobis' two & four-sector model

• Key Events:

○ Industrial Policy of 1956 advocating a socialistic pattern of society

○ Acute shortage of foreign exchange

○ Price rise of around 30%

○ Moderate success despite foreign loan dependency
questions.solution_hi:
• द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना ने तीव्र औद्योगीकरण पर बल दिया, विशेषकर भारी व मूलभूत उद्योगों में।

• इसे विदेशी मुद्रा की कमी व मूल्य वृद्धि जैसी समस्याओं का भी सामना करना पड़ा।

• हालाँकि, यह योजना हैरॉड-डोमर मॉडल व चार-क्षेत्र मॉडल दोनों पर आधारित थी।

questions.q_en:
Which of the following is/are true about the Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979)?

a. It focused on "Garibi Hatao" (removal of poverty) and self-reliance.

b. The plan was terminated early by the Janata Party government.

c. The actual growth rate achieved during this plan was lower than the target.
questions.solution_en:
• The Fifth Five-Year Plan aimed at removal of poverty ("Garibi Hatao") and self-reliance.

• It was terminated early in 1978 when the Janata Party came to power

• The actual growth rate (4.8%) was higher than the targeted 4.4%.

Further Insight:

• Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979)

○ Architect: D.P. Dhar (initially)

○ Target Growth: 4.4%

○ Actual Growth: 4.8%

○ Key Focus: Poverty removal (Garibi Hatao) and self-reliance

○ Key Events:

■ Global oil price shock and inflation

■ Prime Minister's 20-point program after the Emergency (1975)

■ Plan terminated early by the Janata Party government in 1978
questions.solution_hi:
• पाँचवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना का उद्देश्य गरीबी उन्मूलन ("गरीबी हटाओ") व आत्मनिर्भरता था।

• इसे 1978 में जनता पार्टी के सत्ता में आने पर जल्दी समाप्त कर दिया गया।

• वास्तविक वृद्धि दर (4.8%) लक्षित 4.4% से अधिक थी।

questions.q_en:
Regarding the Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992-1997), which of the following is/are true?

a. It was the first plan to introduce economic reforms, including liberalization.

b. The actual growth rate achieved was higher than the targeted rate.

c. It focused primarily on the agricultural sector.
questions.solution_en:
• The Eighth Five-Year Plan was the first to introduce economic reforms, including liberalization.

• The actual growth rate achieved was 6.8%, which was higher than the target of 5.6%.

• The plan did not focus primarily on the agricultural sector but on liberalization and economic reforms.

Further Insight:

• Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979)

○ Architect: D.P. Dhar (initially)

○ Target Growth: 4.4%

○ Actual Growth: 4.8%

○ Key Focus: Poverty removal (Garibi Hatao) and self-reliance

○ Key Events:

■ Global oil price shock and inflation

■ Prime Minister's 20-point program after the Emergency (1975)

• Plan terminated early by the Janata Party government in 1978
questions.solution_hi:
• आठवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना आर्थिक सुधार, उदारीकरण सहित, शुरू करने वाली पहली योजना थी।

• वास्तविक प्राप्त वृद्धि दर 6.8% थी, जो 5.6% के लक्ष्य से अधिक थी।

• यह योजना मुख्यतः कृषि क्षेत्र पर नहीं बल्कि उदारीकरण व आर्थिक सुधार पर केंद्रित थी।

questions.q_en:
Which of the following is/are correct about the Twelfth Five-Year Plan (2012 - 2017)?

a. It aimed for faster, more inclusive, and sustainable growth.

b. It achieved a higher growth rate than the targeted 8%.

c. One of its key focus areas was good governance and transparency.
questions.solution_en:
• The Twelfth Five-Year Plan aimed at faster, more inclusive, and sustainable growth.

• The plan did not achieve the targeted growth rate of 8%, as it ended with a growth rate of 7.5%.

• Good governance and transparency were indeed important focus areas of the plan.

Further Insight:

• Twelfth Five-Year Plan (2012-2017)

○ Target Growth: 8%

○ Actual Growth: 7.5% (initial years saw lower growth due to domestic and global economic challenges)

○ Key Focus: Faster, more inclusive, and sustainable growth

○ Key Events:

■ Focus on improving health, education, infrastructure, and industrial growth

■ Significant improvements in energy and infrastructure

■ Poverty reduction, rural development, and technology-driven innovation.
questions.solution_hi:
• बारहवीं पंचवर्षीय योजना का उद्देश्य तीव्र, अधिक समावेशी व सतत विकास था।

• यह योजना 8% के लक्षित वृद्धि दर को प्राप्त नहीं कर सकी, क्योंकि यह 7.5% की वृद्धि दर के साथ समाप्त हुई।

• सुशासन व पारदर्शिता भी इस योजना के महत्वपूर्ण केंद्र बिंदु थे।
